mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fund_profile (fund_code, return_1m, return_3m, return_6m, return_1y, similar_percent, fund_scale, scale_date, manager_name, manager_star, manager_work_time, manager_size, manager_score, buy_rate, min_buy) VALUES (#{fundCode}, #{return1m}, #{return3m}, #{return6m}, #{return1y}, #{similarPercent}, #{fundScale}, #{scaleDate}, #{managerName}, #{managerStar}, #{managerWorkTime}, #{managerSize}, #{managerScore}, #{buyRate}, #{minBuy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE return_1m = VALUES(return_1m), return_3m = VALUES(return_3m), return_6m = VALUES(return_6m), return_1y = VALUES(return_1y), similar_percent = VALUES(similar_percent), fund_scale = VALUES(fund_scale), scale_date = VALUES(scale_date), manager_name = VALUES(manager_name), manager_star = VALUES(manager_star), manager_work_time = VALUES(manager_work_time), manager_size = VALUES(manager_size), manager_score = VALUES(manager_score), buy_rate = VALUES(buy_rate), min_buy = VALUES(min_buy)

INSERT INTO fund_period_rank (fund_code, period_code, period_name, fund_return, similar_average_return, benchmark_return, rank_no, rank_total, as_of) VALUES
(#{item.fundCode}, #{item.periodCode}, #{item.periodName}, #{item.fundReturn}, #{item.similarAverageReturn}, #{item.benchmarkReturn}, #{item.rankNo}, #{item.rankTotal}, #{item.asOf})
